mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_reports (student_id, report_type, report_date, total_problems, correct_count, score_rate, level_a_count, level_b_count, level_c_count, study_time_sec, weak_units, ai_comment, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{reportType}, #{reportDate}, #{totalProblems}, #{correctCount}, #{scoreRate}, #{levelACount}, #{levelBCount}, #{levelCCount}, #{studyTimeSec}, #{weakUnits}, #{aiComment}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_problems = VALUES(total_problems), correct_count = VALUES(correct_count), score_rate = VALUES(score_rate), level_a_count = VALUES(level_a_count), level_b_count = VALUES(level_b_count), level_c_count = VALUES(level_c_count), study_time_sec = VALUES(study_time_sec), weak_units = VALUES(weak_units), ai_comment = VALUES(ai_comment)
